benchmarkDesign: Frozen retrospective benchmark. The scorer is a symmetric reading of families, lane counters and synergies, confronted with these labels; it is not a roster-to-label table and it is not the separate distillation fit.

gate.declaration: Product acceptance thresholds selected for this prototype; these are not thresholds stated by Kazewa. Passing this retrospective gate would still require prospective validation.

actualMatchOutcome.caveat: Small retrospective subset; neither a calibrated win probability nor evidence that compositions determine match results.

limitations: The method, champion taxonomy and rules were distilled from overlapping Kazewa videos. This is not an independent holdout and does not establish future fidelity.
The primary screening uses explicit keywords; unobserved context can remain and some composition-only reasoning can be excluded conservatively.
Reconstructed rosters in the broader cohort come from existing project dossier headers and answer keys, not a newly verified external match feed.
Broadcast left/right are anonymized as blue/red for exact-extract cases; the engine cannot use first-pick or map-side advantages.
Predictions of Kazewa preference and predictions of actual match winners are distinct outcomes.
The reading was confronted with these same retrospective labels. Agreement on this file is not an independent test, and 70% does not pass the 85% fidelity gate.

exploratoryRaw.name: Exploratory full-review corpus, kept separate from draft-phase benchmark
limitations: Explicit late opinions are excluded, but absence of a late flag is not proof of a pregame judgment. Full-review extraction can retain hindsight and omitted timing context.
Cases conflicting with matched clean draft-phase labels, including an explicit absence of preference, are excluded.
Game numbers restart in multi-series reviews. Clean matches use unambiguous known-pick correspondence; unresolved matches remain marked and cannot establish independence.
Some cases overlap the clean benchmark or method source. This cohort never contributes to the fidelity gate.
